name: Payment gateways
description: The machinery every online payment needs: start a payment for an order, take the gateway's server-to-server callback, verify it, and move the order's payment state — once, in the right order, with every attempt kept. A gateway module supplies the vendor-specific half; this owns the rest.

settings.label: Keep asking about a payment for, hours
settings.help: Every 15 minutes the shop asks the gateway about orders it is still waiting on — a callback can be lost, and on a development machine it never arrives at all. Older than this and an unpaid invoice is not going to be paid.

settings.label: Keep the transaction log, days
settings.help: Raw callbacks are your only evidence in a dispute with the bank, so this is deliberately long. Older rows are swept nightly.
